effect.name: Bevel Smooth (Texture)
effect.description: Shader adds simple lighting to create a sense of depth; the lighting is soft.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Bevel Smooth (Texture) Shader | 2026.06.26 */
parameter.description: Shader adds simple lighting to create a sense of depth; the lighting is soft.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Light Direction
parameter.description: This variable specifies the offset along the X-axis.

parameter.name: Size
parameter.description: This variable specifies the shadow size in pixels

parameter.name: (RGB) Color Light
parameter.description: This variable specifies the color used for the lightest color.

parameter.name: (RGB) Color Shadow
parameter.description: This variable specifies the color used for the darkness color.
